title: Rowing boats
description: This project adds a proper rowing boat to minecraft!
body:
**This mod adds A rowing boat to minecraft**
**Info**
The type of rowing boat this adds is called a single
It is made with all custom recipies made from vanilla ingridients so is easily intergrated into your instance
Probably works well with "Realistic Rowing"
**Bugs**
Is super fast on land because it is a normal entity
The spawn thing is called "Rowing Boat spawn egg" and not just "Rowing Boat"
**Specs**
Client-side only
Neoforge 1.21.8
You can watch a short video about it [Here!](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/yqR_aNnBjh8) Also if you could subscribe to my [YT Channel](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCHPa8xi31S_LrLfv402RPxQ) if you enjoyed this mod it would help me a lot
